name: progressive-blur
title: Progressive Blur
description: A gradual blur over the edge of a scrolling area, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers. Decorative and static.

props.name: position
props.description: Which edge of the nearest positioned ancestor gets the blur.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of each blurred edge, as any CSS length.

props.name: blurLevels
props.description: Blur radius in px for each stacked layer, weakest first. More layers give a smoother ramp.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for each blurred edge.
